description_html:
A one bedroom flat situated on the 3rd floor of arguably one of the most sought after blocks on the Barbican Estate. This Type 20 has been fully refurbished throughout to a high standard by Thomson Brothers.This property features a large L shaped reception room which could be closed off to create a second bedroom, leading on to a South facing balcony overlooking the beautiful resident's gardens. Extended lease.

Within walking distance of Farringdon, Barbican and Moorgate stations. To access the Elizabeth line, Circle, Hammersmith and City line and Thameslink for journeys to Luton and Gatwick Airport.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 170
Service Charge: £7,830 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £10
Council Tax Band: E
